The candidate should have hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC), designing and developing data integration workflows, and supporting data pipelines. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain data integration workflows using Informatica IDMC. Build and optimize mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and synchronization tasks. Develop ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources. Work with cloud and on-premises data sources, databases, flat files, APIs, and other data systems. Implement error handling, logging, scheduling, and workflow dependency management. Collaborate with business analysts, data architects, QA teams, and other developers. Support production deployments, incident resolution, and ongoing maintenance. Follow data governance, security, and development standards. Experience in mappings, transformations, mapping tasks, and taskflows. Good knowledge of SQL, including complex queries, joins, and performance tuning. Experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or similar platforms. Understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, and data modelling. Experience in debugging, performance optimization, and production support. Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred Skills Experience with Informatica Cloud Data Quality (CDQ). Knowledge of REST APIs, web services, and file-based integrations. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Experience with Git, CI/CD, deployment, and version control. title: Mobile App Developer (ios, ReactNative)
description:
What is the work? Develop, maintain, and enhance mobile applications for iOS and cross-platform environments. Work on mobile applications using Native iOS, React Native, and Flutter. Understand requirements and translate them into scalable, secure, and user-friendly mobile solutions. Develop responsive UI using Swift/SwiftUI, React Native, and Flutter. Integrate REST APIs, JSON, GraphQL, Firebase, push notifications, payment SDKs, maps, and third-party SDKs. Implement authentication, authorization, deep linking, secure storage, and offline data handling. Follow appropriate architecture and design patterns such as MVVM, Clean Architecture, Repository Pattern, and suitable state-management approaches. Develop and maintain local storage using technologies such as Core Data/SQLite, Secure Storage, and Firebase/Firestore as applicable. Perform unit, UI, widget, and integration testing and troubleshoot crashes, memory, and performance issues. Manage iOS and cross-platform builds and releases using Xcode, CocoaPods, Gradle, Android Studio, App Store Connect, TestFlight, and Google Play Console as applicable. Use Git/GitHub and participate in code reviews, CI/CD, and release management. Work closely with Backend Developers, QA, UI/UX Designers, Project Managers, and clients. Provide production support, troubleshoot issues, and ensure application quality and performance. 
 What skills and experience are we looking for? 3+ years of professional experience in mobile application development. Strong hands-on experience in at least one of the following: Native iOS: Swift, SwiftUI/UIKit, Xcode, iOS SDK, CocoaPods, iOS application lifecycle. React Native: React Native, JavaScript/TypeScript, React Hooks, Redux/Redux Toolkit, React Navigation, Native Modules. Good understanding of Android/iOS integration for React Native applications. Strong experience with REST APIs, JSON, Firebase, FCM, push notifications, authentication, deep linking, and third-party integrations. Experience with payment SDKs, Google Maps/location services, and local storage. Good understanding of MVVM/Clean Architecture and application security. Experience with unit testing, UI/integration testing, debugging, Crashlytics, and performance optimization. Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub and preferably CI/CD. Experience with mobile application deployment through App Store Connect/TestFlight; Google Play Console experience is an advantage. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Good communication and ability to work with technical and non-technical teams. Experience working with international clients and distributed teams is an advantage. Bachelors degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related discipline is preferred.

Key Skills: Javascript,Swift,React Native,ios,XCode,Mobile application development,iPhone,Mobile development
